messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>

Subject: POC success scorecard & readiness checklist

Hi Amy / Jorge —

Thanks again for the call today. Good alignment on the high-level goals; I wanted to capture the concrete POC success criteria and a short readiness checklist so we can move to scheduling and environment prep. I attached a one-page scorecard (veridian_poc_scorecard.xlsx) and the trial runtime config we typically use.

Proposed POC scope (2-week pilot):
- Workload: customer search assistant (batch re-rank + streaming chat for follow-ups) with 1M tokens of test traffic simulated.
- Success KPIs (pass/fail gates):
  * Latency: p95 generation latency < 250ms for 512-token prompts (target 200ms).
  * Throughput: sustain 45 requests/sec during peak synthetic load with < 5% tail spike failures.
  * Cost: incremental inference cost <= $0.09 per 1k tokens (estimated w/ quantized model + batching).
  * Quality: human-annotated accuracy/intent-match >= 88% on our shared eval set; automated rerank NDCG@10 delta >= +0.12 vs. baseline.

Evaluation plan (short):
1) Week 0 (prep): access + test fixtures from Veridian; deploy trial model to Redwood test pool (we'll provide config).
2) Week 1 (baseline): run baseline traffic and collect metrics, capture p95/p99 and cost per token.
3) Week 2 (tuning & validation): iterate on batching/quantization and run human eval sample.

Ownership (suggested):
- Infrastructure/config: Soojin Lee (Redwood) + Jorge (Veridian infra contact)
- Quality eval: Karthik Iyer (Redwood) + Amy (Veridian PO)
- Customer success & rollout: Ben Carter (Redwood)

Immediate asks for tomorrow:
- Can you share a ~2k example query set and the eval rubric (if available)?
- Confirm whether we can provision a staging VPC endpoint (IP allowlist) or if you prefer API token via your procurement flow.

If that looks good I'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff for Wed (UTC-friendly) and send the invite.

Thanks,
Soojin

Thanks Soojin — this is great and very actionable. A couple of quick clarifications from the commercial side so procurement can plan:

- Duration: we recommend the 2-week pilot but offer a 1-week extension at the same trial pricing if you want more validation.
- Credits/pricing: we'll provide $6k in trial credits that should cover the estimated load; if you need us to quote a committed dedicated node for longer trials let me know and I'll loop in Sales Ops.

Operational notes on the KPIs:
- Latency target: setting p95 200ms as "stretch" and 250ms as "required" makes sense — we'll surface both in the scorecard.
- Cost: the $0.09/1k estimate assumes 8-bit quantization + continuous batching; if you want lower cost we can profile a int4/llm-int8 variant but that will change quality slightly (we'll capture tradeoffs).

Ownership tweak: I'd suggest Evelyn own the trial billing/credits handoff and acceptance sign-off (Evelyn Hart, CS) so procurement has a single contact.

Amy/Jorge — are there any regulatory constraints (data residency, log retention) we should bake into the deployment config?

Happy to align on kickoff time — my calendar is wide Wed afternoon PT.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
